operations.command: mkdir -p '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}' && nix-build tests/boot-touch --arg rotate {{rotate}} --argstr layout {{layout}} --arg light {{light}} --arg multi {{multi}} --arg scale {{scale}} --no-out-link --cores 4 --max-jobs 1 > '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/test.log' 2>&1 || { tail -80 '.vm/e2e/{{state}}-{{stateHashShort}}/test.log'; exit 1; }
